children: ASA approved a proposal to convert from a gold-focused closed-end fund to a yield-oriented business development company.
Board approved proposal to convert ASA into a BDC with a yield‑oriented, credit‑focused strategy.
Board voted to redomicile ASA from Bermuda to Delaware and change its U.S. tax status toward a RIC.
Board selected Saba to serve as the BDC’s investment manager, subject to shareholder approval.
BDC Conversion aims to address ASA’s NAV discount, shift to income investments, and simplify tax/operational structure.
Conversion and related proposals will be voted at the 2026 Annual Meeting; conversion expected by year‑end if approved.
